clear_space.rule: no text, image, rule or container edge may enter the clear-space box

sizing.scaling: scale proportionally only; never set width and height independently

allowed_pairings.note: display only — contrast is ~2.5:1, below the 3:1 floor for small sizes

color.on_photography: cream mark over a #3B241B scrim at 40% opacity
color.contrast_rule: at 32px and below the mark must clear 3:1 against its background; above 48px the coral-on-light pairing is permitted as display treatment

lockup.alignment: wordmark optical center aligns to the vertical center of the mark's bounding box
lockup.stacked_variant: mark above wordmark, gap 0.4 * mark width, both centered
lockup.build: compose in the host environment: place the coral mark, then typeset 'PawPi' beside it in Nunito ExtraBold. No SVG ships with the wordmark baked in — outline the text yourself if you need a font-independent file.

app_icon.mark: #FFF7EF at 62% of canvas width, optically centered

small_size_behaviour.below_32px: solid single colour only, no lockup, no wordmark
small_size_behaviour.below_20px: do not use the mark; use the wordmark or a coral dot

never: rotate, mirror, skew or re-angle either paw
change the distance or offset between the two paws
recolour the two paws differently from each other
add outline, stroke, drop shadow, gradient, glow or bevel
place the mark inside a shape that crops the clear-space box
redraw, retrace or substitute the system emoji for the mark
stretch, condense or set width and height independently
use the mark as a repeating pattern at under 48px
